title: Parallel transfer item: systematic
instructions: Choose the meaning that best fits the sentence.

parts.prompt: Rather than checking the equipment at random, Mira used a systematic method: she tested every item in the same order and recorded each result. What does “systematic” most nearly mean?

options.text: organised according to a clear method

choice_rationales.A: The explanation describes a consistent order and recorded method.
choice_rationales.B: Mira records every result, so the work is not undocumented.
choice_rationales.C: The method stays consistent instead of changing randomly.
choice_rationales.D: The sentence describes organisation, not speed.

parts.hint: Use the contrast with ‘at random’ and the explanation after the colon.
parts.correct_explanation: A systematic method follows an organised, consistent procedure.
